title: A Structural Characterization of Determinantally Equivalent Functions
summary: Let $Λ$ be a set and $\mathbb{F}$ a field. Suppose that $K,Q:Λ^2\to\mathbb{F}$ are two functions such that for any $n\in\mathbb{N}$ and $x_1,x_2,\ldots,x_n\inΛ$, the determinants of matrices $(K(x_i,x_j))_{1\leq i,j\leq n}$ and $(Q(x_i,x_j))_{1\leq i,j\leq n}$ agree. We study to what extent $K$ and $Q$ must be related by two canonical transformations corresponding to diagonal similarity and transposition. In the symmetric case, this relation holds without further assumptions (see [Marco Stevens, Equivalent symmetric kernels of determinantal point processes, RMTA, 10(03):2150027, 2021]),…
